0022600206.text: The Toronto Raptors host the Memphis Grizzlies with Toronto at 4-4 overall, 2-1 at home, and on a one-game losing streak, while Memphis is 6-2 overall and 4-0 on the road. Toronto is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), and Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The Raptors won both meetings last season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
